- function: Component of the box H/ACA small nucleolar ribonucleoprotein (H/ACA snoRNP) complex, which catalyzes pseudouridylation of rRNA (Probable). This involves the isomerization of uridine such that the ribose is subsequently attached to C5, instead of the normal N1 (Probable). Pseudouridine ('psi') residues may serve to stabilize the conformation of rRNAs (Probable). Required for ribosome biogenesis (By similarity). entities.name: NHP2 Drosophila
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt Q9V3U2, a reviewed H/ACA ribonucleoprotein complex subunit 2 from Drosophila melanogaster; 160 aa and 100% query/target coverage.
Contains a Ribosomal_L7Ae domain (PF01248), positions 52–145, supporting an H/ACA snoRNA-associated RNA-binding role.
Part of the box H/ACA snoRNP complex with Nop60B, Gar1, and Nop10.
Localized to the nucleus and nucleolus.
Participates in snoRNA-guided rRNA and snRNA pseudouridine synthesis and supports ribosome biogenesis.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight about 17.7 kDa, theoretical pI 8.25, mildly positive charge at pH 7; no explicit catalytic reaction retrieved.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence identity, domain, function, localization, complex, and GO annotations

entities.name: H/ACA snoRNP pseudouridylation
observations: H/ACA snoRNP complexes guide conversion of selected uridines in precursor rRNA and some snRNAs to pseudouridine; NHP2 is a structural RNA-binding subunit rather than the catalytic pseudouridine synthase.
The process contributes to ribosome biogenesis and maturation of stable functional rRNA.

entities.name: Nucleus and nucleolus
observations: Curated reference annotation places NHP2 in the nucleus, especially the nucleolus, consistent with assembly and activity of H/ACA snoRNP complexes.
